messages:
Maya (CSM): Morning — starting onboarding sync for Clara / EdgeOps. Goal: 14-day healthcheck to validate performance, security checks, and handoff to support. Can we confirm primary success criteria and any immediate renewal risks?

Clara (Customer PM): Thanks @Maya. Primary success criteria: 1) baseline latency < 150ms p95 for our typical prompts, 2) embedding quality for search > 0.78 (internal eval), 3) end-to-end dev flow with tokens billing predictable. Renewal: none immediate but scope creep could push cost concerns.

Raj (AE): Noted — I'll flag cost sensitivity with Finance. If we see >20% higher unit cost we should loop them in. Also confirming legal already signed EULA, so no contract blockers.

Lin (OnboardEng): Draft 14-day plan below — propose we follow it unless you want changes @Clara.

Lin (OnboardEng): ```
Day 0: account + API keys, IP allowlist, KMS access request
Day 1-2: smoke tests + small perf runs (10k tokens)
Day 3: perf baseline (p50/p95) + KV/prefix cache check
Day 5: model variant tuning (quant vs fp16) and cost sim
Day 7: integration test with search/embeddings path
Day 10: guardrails and monitoring setup (alerts + dashboards)
Day 14: sign-off + handoff to support + feedback capture
```

Lin (OnboardEng): Access needed: API key, service account for telemetry, IP allowlist CIDRs, KMS ARN for encryption.

EdgeOps (customer): We can provide IP ranges by EOD. KMS needs SRE approval — I'll start that ticket. Also need a 2-hour VPC peering window next week (prefer Tue 9–11am PT).

Maya (CSM): Great — can we lock Tue 9–11am PT for the peering? If so I'll put the weekly check there. @Raj want to join the first sync to cover billing? :thumbsup:

Raj (AE): I'll join Tue 9am PT. Also can run a quick cost-sensitivity demo in the 15m at the start.

Clara (Customer PM): Tue 9am works for us. For success criteria I want a short acceptance checklist we can sign off on after Day 14. Can Lin draft a 3-item sign-off we can attach to the ticket?

Lin (OnboardEng): Will do. Draft sign-off: 1) perf within targets, 2) end-to-end integration passing smoke tests, 3) monitoring + alerting hooked to oncall. I'll post it before the Tue sync.

Maya (CSM): Quick note on renewal risk: Clara, if we see a model variant that materially increases cost, Raj and I will propose a mitigation (batching/caching or smaller model) and get approval before production. We should capture any feature wishes that would increase tokens too.

EdgeOps (customer): Also curious about data residency — do we get logs stored only in our region? Need to confirm for compliance.

Lin (OnboardEng): Yes — we can pin logging region for the private deployment. I'll include config snippet in the onboarding docs.

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created — https://redwood.example/onboarding/EDGEOPS-1965 — first reminder scheduled for 48h.

Maya (CSM): Action items so far:
- Lin: post Day 14 sign-off checklist before Tue sync (ACTION)
- EdgeOps: provide IP ranges + open KMS approval ticket (ACTION)
- Raj: prepare 15m cost sensitivity demo Tue (ACTION)
- Clara: confirm any extra perf prompts to include in eval (ACTION)

Maya (CSM): If no objections I'll set recurring Tue 9am PT for the first two weeks then switch to weekly.

Clara (Customer PM): Sounds good. One more ask: can we capture qualitative feedback from the devs after Day 7? I can run a short survey.

Maya (CSM): Perfect — add a feedback capture card to the Day 7 checklist.

Raj (AE): Thanks all. I'll post a calendar invite.

Lin (OnboardEng): Posting the sign-off checklist now and attaching perf test snippets.```
